        "diffString": "- \n+ \"\"\"\n+ Blender version helpers for BasedPlayblast.\n+ \n+ Keeps the add-on logic clean by centralizing all version comparisons and\n+ common constants for the supported tracks (4.4 LTS, 4.5 LTS, 5.0+).\n+ \"\"\"\n+ \n+ from __future__ import annotations\n+ \n+ try:  # Blender runtime\n+     import bpy  # type: ignore\n+ except ImportError:  # During static analysis or packaging\n+     bpy = None  # type: ignore\n+ \n+ # Targeted LTS anchors\n+ VERSION_4_4_LTS = (4, 4, 0)\n+ VERSION_4_5_LTS = (4, 5, 0)\n+ VERSION_5_0 = (5, 0, 0)\n+ \n+ \n+ def _current_version() -&gt; tuple[int, int, int]:\n+     \"\"\"Return Blender's version tuple or a fallback.\"\"\"\n+     if bpy and getattr(bpy.app, \"version\", None):\n+         return bpy.app.version  # type: ignore[return-value]\n+     return (0, 0, 0)\n+ \n+ \n+ def get_blender_version() -&gt; tuple[int, int, int]:\n+     return _current_version()\n+ \n+ \n+ def get_version_string() -&gt; str:\n+     v = _current_version()\n+     return f\"{v[0]}.{v[1]}.{v[2]}\"\n+ \n+ \n+ def is_version_at_least(major: int, minor: int = 0, patch: int = 0) -&gt; bool:\n+     current = _current_version()\n+     return current &gt;= (major, minor, patch)\n+ \n+ \n+ def is_version_less_than(major: int, minor: int = 0, patch: int = 0) -&gt; bool:\n+     current = _current_version()\n+     return current &lt; (major, minor, patch)\n+ \n+ \n+ def get_version_category() -&gt; str:\n+     \"\"\"\n+     Collapse Blender versions into the compatibility buckets we actively test.\n+     \"\"\"\n+     major, minor, _ = _current_version()\n+     if major &lt; 4:\n+         return f\"{major}.{minor}\"\n+     if major == 4 and minor &lt; 5:\n+         return \"4.4\"\n+     if major == 4:\n+         return \"4.5\"\n+     return \"5.0+\"\n+ \n+ \n+ def is_supported() -&gt; bool:\n+     \"\"\"Check if the detected version is at least our minimum target.\"\"\"\n+     return not is_version_less_than(*VERSION_4_4_LTS)\n+ ",

  "contentsAfterEdit": "\"\"\"\r\nBlender version helpers for BasedPlayblast.\r\n\r\nKeeps the add-on logic clean by centralizing all version comparisons and\r\ncommon constants for the supported tracks (4.4 LTS, 4.5 LTS, 5.0+).\r\n\"\"\"\r\n\r\nfrom __future__ import annotations\r\n\r\ntry:  # Blender runtime\r\n    import bpy  # type: ignore\r\nexcept ImportError:  # During static analysis or packaging\r\n    bpy = None  # type: ignore\r\n\r\n# Targeted LTS anchors\r\nVERSION_4_4_LTS = (4, 4, 0)\r\nVERSION_4_5_LTS = (4, 5, 0)\r\nVERSION_5_0 = (5, 0, 0)\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _current_version() -&gt; tuple[int, int, int]:\r\n    \"\"\"Return Blender's version tuple or a fallback.\"\"\"\r\n    if bpy and getattr(bpy.app, \"version\", None):\r\n        return bpy.app.version  # type: ignore[return-value]\r\n    return (0, 0, 0)\r\n\r\n\r\ndef get_blender_version() -&gt; tuple[int, int, int]:\r\n    return _current_version()\r\n\r\n\r\ndef get_version_string() -&gt; str:\r\n    v = _current_version()\r\n    return f\"{v[0]}.{v[1]}.{v[2]}\"\r\n\r\n\r\ndef is_version_at_least(major: int, minor: int = 0, patch: int = 0) -&gt; bool:\r\n    current = _current_version()\r\n    return current &gt;= (major, minor, patch)\r\n\r\n\r\ndef is_version_less_than(major: int, minor: int = 0, patch: int = 0) -&gt; bool:\r\n    current = _current_version()\r\n    return current &lt; (major, minor, patch)\r\n\r\n\r\ndef get_version_category() -&gt; str:\r\n    \"\"\"\r\n    Collapse Blender versions into the compatibility buckets we actively test.\r\n    \"\"\"\r\n    major, minor, _ = _current_version()\r\n    if major &lt; 4:\r\n        return f\"{major}.{minor}\"\r\n    if major == 4 and minor &lt; 5:\r\n        return \"4.4\"\r\n    if major == 4:\r\n        return \"4.5\"\r\n    return \"5.0+\"\r\n\r\n\r\ndef is_supported() -&gt; bool:\r\n    \"\"\"Check if the detected version is at least our minimum target.\"\"\"\r\n    return not is_version_less_than(*VERSION_4_4_LTS)\r\n\r\n"

icon_only=True, emboss=False)\r\n        row.label(text=\"Properties\")\r\n        row.operator(\"bpl.apply_user_defaults\", text=\"\", icon='PREFERENCES')\r\n        \r\n        if show_props:\r\n Display Mode\r\n            display_box = props_box.box()\r\n            display_box.label(text=\"Display Mode\", icon='SHADING_RENDERED')\r\n            col = display_box.column(align=True)\r\n            col.prop(props, \"display_mode\", text=\"\")\r\n            col.prop(props, \"auto_disable_overlays\")\r\n            col.prop(props, \"enable_depth_of_field\")\r\n            \r\n            # 2. Metadata\r\n            metadata_box = props_box.box()\r\n            metadata_box.label(text=\"Metadata\", icon='TEXT')\r\n            col = metadata_box.column(align=True)\r\n            col.prop(props, \"show_metadata\", text=\"Show Metadata\")\r\n            \r\n            if props.show_metadata:\r\n                col.prop(props, \"metadata_note\", text=\"\")\r\n                \r\n                row = col.row(align=True)\r\n                row.prop(props, \"metadata_date\", toggle=True)\r\n                row.prop(props, \"metadata_frame\", toggle=True)\r\n                row.prop(props, \"metadata_scene\", toggle=True)\r\n                \r\n                row = col.row(align=True)\r\n                row.prop(props, \"metadata_camera\", toggle=True)\r\n                row.prop(props, \"metadata_lens\", toggle=True)\r\n                row.prop(props, \"metadata_resolution\", toggle=True)\r\n\r\n# Define the addon preferences class\r\nclass BPL_AddonPreferences(AddonPreferences):\r\n    bl_idname = __name__\r\n    \r\n    default_video_quality: EnumProperty(\r\n        name=\"Default Video Quality\",\r\n        description=\"Default quality setting for the add-on. ## Updates
- Added reusable version + compatibility modules so we no longer scatter `bpy.app.version` checks across the add-on; helpers now centralize version buckets (4.4 LTS, 4.5 LTS, 5.0+) and rendering shims such as safe OpenGL invocation and studio-light resolution.
```1:58:utils/version.py
"""
Blender version helpers for BasedPlayblast.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

try:
    import bpy  # type: ignore
except ImportError:
    bpy = None  # type: ignore

VERSION_4_4_LTS = (4, 4, 0)
VERSION_4_5_LTS = (4, 5, 0)
VERSION_5_0 = (5, 0, 0)

def get_blender_version() -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    if bpy and getattr(bpy.app, "version", None):
        return bpy.app.version  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return (0, 0, 0)

def get_version_category() -> str:
    major, minor, _ = get_blender_version()
    if major == 4 and minor < 5:
        return "4.4"
    if major == 4:
        return "4.5"
    return "5.0+"
```
- Refactored the main operator to use the compat helpers for video-format selection, viewport OpenGL rendering, and HDRI discovery, so Blender 4.4/4.5/5.0 paths all flow through the same code.
```440:907:__init__.py
